song_craft: Voice: śāstra-hammer couplets continued (p01 voice holds — same proof, same hammer). Arc: ungrounded-cannot-ground (v10) → this/I fitting (v11) → four offices (v12) → autonomy dawn (v13) → no experience outside grasp (v14) → FIRST LANDING rest (v15) → twofold one, verbless (v16) → SECOND LANDING no-other (v17) → seal: nothing past shining (v18). Two landings inside one song — śama settling twice (rasa block). L3 hammer-tight throughout: L4 = L3 verbatim, music named per verse.

lines: Unwon in final grounding, even by her become self-nature —
how would she bear another being's ground, its standing-place?
l4.sanskrit_cite: saivaṃ bhūtātmanā svenāpy alabdhapariniṣṭhitiḥ katham anyasya bhāvasya pratiṣṭhāspadatām iyāt

verses.craft: Feminine kept (she/her per BOUNDARY — saṃvit is she, not it; row 11 deixis). Unwon-finality disqualifies: the question demolishes by asking.
verses.rejected: (a) neuter it → killed by BOUNDARY. (b) softening the question → killed: the question IS the demolition.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: Saying 'this,' awareness grows fit to ground another's shine —
l4.sanskrit_cite: idam ity ucitaḥ saṃvit prakāśe 'nyasya vastunaḥ pratiṣṭhātmakatāṃ gacched aham ity ātmanā punaḥ

verses.craft: Quotative engine: Saying this / saying I — parallel placement (row 3); the this/I polarity is the doctrine, kept verbatim.
verses.rejected: (a) merging the two sayings → killed: polarity collapse = doctrine collapse. (b) grows fit→becomes fit → killed: ucita-aptitude, L3 frozen.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: By parting and by pairing both, assurance stands declared —
fixed order, ground, attainment, full close — of the other inert selves.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyatireketarābhyām hi niścayo 'nyajaḍātmanoḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate

verses.craft: Four-offices catalogue (order/ground/winning/winding-up); double-concomitance frame kept with the Vṛ (BOUNDARY).
verses.rejected: (a) trimming catalogue → killed: offices are content. (b) bare-mūla the-other → killed: Vṛ-reading settled at L0 grounds.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: So these inert ones, near-unreal in themselves, are shining's —
shining alone is — of its own self, through selves both own and other.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam ātmany asatkalpāḥ prakāśasyaiva santy amī jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ

verses.craft: Ownership enacted: are shinings (identity, not belonging); autonomy dawns mid-line (shining alone is).
verses.rejected: (a) belongs to shining → killed: belonging stated as identity is the move. (b) smoothing near-unreal → killed: asatkalpa load term.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: Apart from distinct-and-indistinct assurance, no experience stands —
none apart from linked shining, whose self is ungrasping.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na caivānubhavo 'py asti bhinnābhinnaviniścayam muktvānvayasya prakāśasya vimarśarahitātmanaḥ

verses.craft: Inseparable pair kept whole (distinct-and-indistinct); no experience outside it.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving the pair → killed: the pair IS the term (bhinnābhinna-viniścaya). (b) stands→is → killed: sthā-verbs carry standing-doctrine.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: Cut off, this 'this'-grasping finds fulfillment thus:
rest in own form — that grasp, 'I am this,' is this itself.
l4.sanskrit_cite: idam ity asya vicchinnavimarśasya kṛtārthatā yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir vimarśaḥ so 'ham ity ayam

verses.craft: FIRST LANDING (rasa: śama lands here): rest in own form — fulfillment as rest, not climax. Done-ness (kṛtārthatā) enacted in falling cadence.
verses.rejected: (a) heightening fulfillment → killed: rest here is anti-climax by doctrine. (b) unpacking I-am-this → killed: the formula is the seal, verbatim.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: One self, twofold: measured and unmeasured —
breath-bound, an atom; supreme self, unbroken.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvidhā sa eṣa evātmā mito 'parimitas tathā prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA (dvidhā … niruddho 'ṇuḥ … akhaṇḍitaḥ)

verses.craft: Verbless nominal lines kept verbless (L3 note + SA verblessness): no verbs smuggled — agency withheld is the point; end-weight unbroken.
verses.rejected: (a) adding is/measured verbs → killed: verbs would import what the verse withholds. (b) atom→particle → killed: aṇu load term.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: For both, this one end-ground of all thing-awarenesses —
one through linking alone. So no other can stand.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ubhayo 'py eṣa paryantabhūmiḥ sarvārthasaṃvidām eka evānusandhānād ato 'nyo nopapadyate
notes: line 1 nominal, mirroring verbless SA; spine carried by line 2

verses.craft: SECOND LANDING: No other can stand — continuity (anusaṃdhāna) gathers both measures; spine in line 2 per L3 note.
verses.rejected: (a) explaining linking → killed: never gloss load terms in song. (b) can→shall → killed: modal shift smuggles necessity.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF / C1 essence / rasa śama-settling-twice + wonder-at-twofold / NOTE KEY TERMS + BOUNDARY (feminine kept, Vṛ-readings settled)

lines: And in I-knowing whose self is non-parting grasp, limit-dwelling —
l4.sanskrit_cite: na cāpy avyatirekātmavimarśātmany ahaṃvidi bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam

verses.craft: Seal: last word shows — shining shows itself showing; song ends inside its own verb. Rupture: limit-dwelling, then nothing past shining.
verses.rejected: (a) appears (L2) → killed: L3 frozen + shows is active. (b) expanding limit-dwelling → killed: paryantavartin kept packed (row 2 pressure).
